title: Gold hits over one-year low ahead of Fed minutes
text: Gold prices have plummeted to their lowest since October 2025, driven by a robust US dollar and rising interest rate expectations. The Federal Reserve's officials emphasized the necessity for additional hikes to tackle inflation effectively. Investors are keenly awaiting the forthcoming minutes from the Federal Open Market Committee for clearer direction. Meanwhile, other precious metals, including silver, platinum, and palladium, have also seen significant price drops.
